title: Tokyo client roadshow — prep & expense cheatsheet
content:
Purpose: quick, transportable notes for the Tokyo client roadshow (3 cities: Tokyo, Yokohama, Chiba). This is a personal scratchpad — operational checklist + expense rules + vendor contacts + templates for receipts/descriptions. Keep short; update as things confirm.

High-level schedule (draft):
- Day 0 (arrive): land NRT 09:30 local, transfer to hotel, quick rest, hotel call with local event ops at 16:00 JST.
- Day 1: client workshop A (09:00–12:30), lunch hosted by client (expense covered by client). Afternoon: 1:1s + prep for evening dinner. Dinner with client execs (company pays — corporate card preferred).
- Day 2: demo + customer site visit in Yokohama (08:00 depart by hired van). Evening: internal sync call (UK overlap 22:00 JST).
- Day 3: Chiba partner meeting (10:30), fly home NRT 19:00

Quick travel/ops notes: 
- Always ask vendors for itemized receipts (English ok). No handwritten single-line kcal.
- Photo receipts immediately: use Expensify app / extract via corporate expense flow. If using personal card, mark as "personal-pay" and attach receipt + note with approver name.
- Corporate card: use for hotels, van rental, dinner, internal taxis. If client explicitly covers a meal, still capture receipt but tag as "client-paid".
- Per diem (internal guidance): JP per diem policy = ¥6,000/day meal allowance (use only if small incidental expenses and using personal funds). If using corporate card, do NOT claim per diem.
- Currency: pay attention to small cash purchases (coin lockers, coffee). Convert to JPY on day of purchase when possible (expense app handles conversion).
- Local SIM: buy pocket Wi‑Fi at airport booth (recommended vendor: Japan Wi‑Fi Co.) or pick up preordered eSIM (Airalo worked for me in 2024). Keep vendor receipt.

Expense coding (common):
- Travel / Flights: EXP: TRAVEL-APAC-FLIGHTS
- Hotels: EXP: TRAVEL-APAC-HOTEL
- Ground transport (van/taxi): EXP: TRAVEL-APAC-GROUND
- Client meals (company-paid): EXP: TRAVEL-APAC-MEALS
- Client-covered items: tag 'client-paid' and include client PO/confirm email
- Misc (SIM, lockers): EXP: TRAVEL-APAC-MISC

Templates & required fields for each expense line (copy into expense app):
- short_description: "TKY roadshow — client dinner with {client-name}"
- attendees: "Maya Chen; Kenji Sato; {client-name}"
- purpose: "Sales: roadshow + product demo; follow-up: roadmap alignment"
- linked_docs: paste Confluence meeting page or embed meeting invite URL

Receipt scanning rules (don't skip):
- Every receipt must have date, vendor, amount, and who paid. If any field missing, add a short note in the expense entry.
- Taxi: if no printed receipt, take photo of driver's receipt (or capture journey screenshot from JapanTaxi app). For hired vans, get company invoice with breakdown (km, hours).

Vendor contacts (save to phone / sim card):
- Sakura Logistics (van rental / driver): contact: Kenji (operations lead) — kenji@sakura-logi.co.jp / +81-80-3456-7788 (ask for NA-English speaking driver).
- Nihon Pocket Wi‑Fi: orders: orders@nihonwifi.jp / +81-3-6721-9002 (airport pick-up counter B, Terminal 1).
- Hotel Tokyo Central — corporate bookings: reservations@tokyocentral.co.jp / +81-3-1234-5678 (booking reference: Redwood GTS — ask for early check-in).
- Yoko Conference Center (AV & catering): av@yokoconf.jp / events@yokoconf.jp / +81-45-987-3321 (contact Kenta Tanaka).
- Recommended dinner venue (client friendly): Izakaya Maru — reservation contact: marureservations@gmail.com / +81-50-1234-2222 (private room X).

Vendor payment preferences: card accepted for hotels/wi‑fi; van rentals sometimes require company invoice and bank transfer — confirm 2 weeks in advance.

On-call / escalation + emergency numbers:
- Redwood security on-call (APAC): +1-415-555-01 (use for lost devices or policy incidents)
- Local emergency (Japan): 119 (ambulance/fire), 110 (police)
- If passport lost: US Consulate Tokyo — +81-3-5232-4111 (hours vary); British Consulate — +81-3-5798-2000

Meeting prep checklist (2 days before):
- Confirm AV+projector with AV contact, test remote mic/headset, send slide deck PDF to local AV (deadline: 48h prior).
- Confirm headcount for lunch/dinner with client (send final list 24h prior).
- Print 10 business cards + 10 one-pagers (handout) — local printers: Shinjuku Express Print (turnaround 4h).

Packing & travel kit (my notes):
- Power adapters (JP type A), USB-C hub, dongles for HDMI, laptop charger, dongle for ethernet (hotel rarely has RJ45).
- Small cash (¥10,000) split across wallet and luggage for small vendors and taxis.
- Portable battery + travel router in case of flaky hotel Wi‑Fi.

Meeting scripts & quick phrases (for non-Japanese speakers):
- "Good morning, thank you for having us." -> "Ohayou gozaimasu. Kondo wa arigatou gozaimasu." (practice)
- Ask client to confirm expense invoicing preference early: "Will you provide a PO or invoice for the covered meal?"

Open items / questions to resolve (TODO):
- [ ] Confirm van invoice process with finance (Kenji to escalate). Finance contact: finance-ops@redwood.ai — ask if vendor bank transfer needs 2-sign approvals.
- [ ] Confirm per-diem applicability for team leads traveling on corporate card. (Priya to check with People Ops)
- [ ] Secure final client dinner headcount by 2026-03-05.
- [ ] Preorder SIM or pocket Wi‑Fi? (Pros: stable internet; Cons: extra receipt to manage).

Post-trip write-up template (copy into Confluence after return):
- title: "Tokyo Roadshow — outcomes & follow-ups (date)"
- bullets: confirmed contracts, leads, engineering follow-ups (PRs/roadmap requests), client feedback (product/regression), ops notes (vendors, invoice issues), expense summary (total company spend + outstanding reimbursement requests).

Notes to self: keep a small laminated card with corporate card number last-4 and emergency contact. Don’t rely on hotel shuttle — confirm timing with driver. If a vendor asks to invoice Redwood US entity, route to finance-ops and cc local sales lead.

Rapid links:
- Expense app guide: https://expenses.redwood.ai/guide (attach receipts under 'APAC trips')
- Confluence draft page: /team/gts/tokyo-roadshow (use for meeting notes)
- Jira trip ticket: RDW-3148 (expenses + ops)

End of scratchpad. Update on the fly — this doc is my single source for receipts, vendor numbers, and quick codes.
